select fr.id as name, fr.description as description, group_concat(distinct CASE WHEN rrr.ref_type = 1 THEN rrr.entity_id END) as userIds, group_concat(distinct CASE WHEN rrr.ref_type = 2 THEN rrr.entity_id END) as userGroupIds from folib_role fr left join role_resource_ref rrr on fr.id = rrr.role_id where fr.deleted = "0" and fr.id = #{roleId} group by fr.id;

select rrr.*, r.api_authoritie, r.storage_id , r.repository_id , r.`path` from folib_role fr left join role_resource_ref rrr on fr.id = rrr.role_id left join resource r on rrr.resource_id = r.id where fr.id = #{roleId} and fr.deleted = 0;
